# Salavai Laundry – Nammude Laundry

> Salavai Laundry (also known as Nammude Laundry) is a Self Income Generating Platform and laundry business setup company based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India. The company empowers traditional dhobi families, homemakers, differently-abled individuals, unemployed youth, and aspiring entrepreneurs to build sustainable laundry businesses using LG commercial equipment.

## Business Identity

- **Business Name:** Salavai Laundry / Nammude Laundry
- **Tagline:** Self-Income Generating Program
- **Type:** Laundry Business Setup & Franchise Support
- **Location:** Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India
- **Website:** https://www.thesalavailaundry.com
- **Phone:** +91 9944328471
- **Email:** contact@nammudelaundry.com
- **Language Support:** English, Malayalam

## What We Do

Salavai Laundry provides end-to-end laundry franchise support including:

1. Complete business setup (store design, branding, equipment installation)
2. Supply of LG commercial washing machines and dryers (10kg, 15kg, gas-powered)
3. Comprehensive training in machine operation, fabric care, business management
4. Marketing support including digital marketing
5. Ongoing mentorship and guidance
6. CSR and government scheme linkage for financial assistance

## Who We Serve

- Traditional dhobi families seeking to modernize their craft
- Homemakers seeking financial independence
- Differently-abled individuals (inclusive employment)
- Unemployed youth wanting to start a business
- Aspiring small business owners with low capital

## Equipment We Provide

- **LG Commercial Washer** – Direct Drive, coin-operated, smart controls
- **LG 10kg Dryer** – Compact commercial dryer with sensor technology
- **LG Titan 15kg Dryer** – High-volume electric dryer
- **LG Gas Dryer** – Cost-effective gas-powered commercial dryer

## Training Modules

1. Laundry machine operation and troubleshooting
2. Advanced fabric handling and stain removal
3. End-to-end workflow and shop management
4. Hygiene, safety, and quality assurance
5. Customer service and pricing strategies
6. Customer relationship management
7. Profit optimization methods

## Franchise Package Includes

- Complete business setup
- Store design and branding
- Brand name rights
- LG laundry equipment
- Full training and skilled staff
- Marketing support
- Digital marketing
- Ongoing guidance

## CSR & Government Support

Salavai Laundry partners with:
- Corporate CSR programs
- Banks (loan facilitation)
- Government self-employment schemes
- Skill development programs

Through these partnerships, financial assistance and training are provided to eligible candidates.

## Vision

To strengthen local economies and empower individuals to achieve financial independence through organized laundry entrepreneurship. To transform traditional laundry skills into sustainable professional businesses that improve quality of life and create scalable economic opportunity across Kerala.
